notes:
My Cashbook: when the company owes you money, Ask for reimbursement on your wallet asks for exactly that amount. Each expense now takes a category from the company's list, and you can close a book once its work is done.

Every book has a PDF button at the top. Pick a report and it opens straight away. Every report now ends with the full list of entries, there is a new day-wise report with a category summary, and bill photos can go into any report.

Advances now go to the CEO or MD first, then to the cashbook manager, who pays them. The money reaches your wallet once it is paid.

For approvers: tick several cashbook entries, or Select all, to approve or reject them together.

Boys Incentive: Record a day is now at the top of the screen.

Recruitment: record which consultancy a candidate came through.

Sunday and comp-off duty lists show only what still needs a decision.

Fixed: the My Team attendance export, and Today's Attendance when you change the day or the department.
